# Evaluation: oral-resnet18-mendeley-v1

*Generated by `ai-service/scripts/evaluate-cancer-models.py` on 2026-11-16.*

**Data:** Mendeley Oral Images Dataset v2 (Chandrashekar et al., CC BY 4.0), fixed image-group split from training: validation split for calibration, test split for metrics. The test split was inspected during earlier development (research/CANCER_MODEL_IMPROVEMENT.md), so it is not a new blind test.

Calibration split: 49 images. Test split: 48 images (48 groups).

## Headline metrics (test split, argmax decision)

| Metric | Value (95% CI) |
|---|---|
| Accuracy | 85.4% (72.8-92.8) |
| Balanced accuracy | 85.5% |
| Macro F1 | 0.854 |
| Macro AUC (one vs rest) | 0.894 |
| Cancer vs not: sensitivity | 87.0% (67.9-95.5) |
| Cancer vs not: specificity | 84.0% (65.3-93.6) |
| Cancer vs not: F1 | 0.851 |
| Cancer vs not: AUC | 0.894 (0.794-0.971) |

Cancer classes in the binary view: malignant_lesion. Intervals: Wilson score for proportions, stratified-free bootstrap (2,000 resamples) for AUC.
